newsitem.title: USA: CBO says interest rate rises would raise deficit.
newsitem.headline: CBO says interest rate rises would raise deficit.

text.p: Congressional Budget Office Director June O'Neill said Thursday that increases in interest rates of about a quarter point would raise the budget deficit by about $50 billion over five years.
O'Neill told a House Budget Committee hearing that tax cuts which are credits to families were unlikely to have any positive effect on the economy.
She also said that tuition tax credits were unlikely to lead to changes in college enrollment.
